name: im-mcp-codeagent
description: Generate auditable MCP Servers from YunOS HDT and supported Android apps (Claude Code + Codex).

interface.shortDescription: Generate MCP Servers from YunOS HDT and Android apps.
interface.longDescription: Imports application source, analyzes source-backed interfaces, scaffolds an MCP Server, and visualizes the gated bridge from target schema to runtime tools.
defaultPrompt: Scaffold an MCP server from a YunOS HDT or Android app source tree.
Generate the rpc-bridge and car-side RpcEngine wiring.
